rolled_out_note: rolled_out = an in_bowl True->False transition at a tick where the ball was not held (computed from the tracker history). TrialTracker.rolled_out latches any such transition, including the held ball crossing the rim+radius z band during LOWER/RELEASE; that raw value is kept per trial as tracker_rolled_out_raw.
ik_rejections_note: ik_rejections count IK solves rejected during PRE_GRASP..RETREAT only; the DONE phase holds the current pose without solving IK.
